response.overview: Directed by Daniel B. Levin, 14 Days in Gainesville returns to the fall of 1990, when Gainesville, Florida, found itself caught between tremendous anticipation and unimaginable tragedy. Steve Spurrier, the Heisman Trophy winner, had returned to his alma mater as head football coach, promising to breathe new life into a program searching for a new era of success. At the same time, the university community was shaken by the murders of five students over a matter of days.
response.title: 14 Days in Gainesville
